AND i.symbol=#{symbol}), (SELECT MAX(it.effective_from) FROM instrument_theme it JOIN instrument i ON i.id=it.instrument_id JOIN theme t ON t.id=it.theme_id WHERE t.code=#{code} AND i.symbol=#{symbol} AND it.effective_from<=#{date} AND (it.effective_to IS NULL OR it.effective_to>=#{date})) )

SELECT c.id, c.theme_id, c.code, c.scope, c.title, c.source_document_id, c.available_at, c.effective_from, c.effective_to, c.expected_members, c.content_hash, c.definition_json, c.created_at, d.url source_url, d.title source_title, d.published_at source_published_at, d.fetched_at source_fetched_at FROM theme_research_cohort c JOIN source_document d ON d.id=c.source_document_id WHERE c.id= ( SELECT c.id FROM theme_research_cohort c JOIN theme t ON t.id=c.theme_id JOIN source_document d ON d.id=c.source_document_id WHERE t.code=#{code} AND c.available_at<=TIMESTAMP(#{date},'16:10:00') AND d.published_at<=TIMESTAMP(#{date},'16:10:00') AND c.effective_from<=#{date} AND (c.effective_to IS NULL OR c.effective_to>=#{date}) ORDER BY c.available_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT s.id, s.theme_id, s.trade_date, s.model_version, s.score, s.rs20, s.breadth, s.coverage, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.evidence_json, s.day_return, s.is_synthetic FROM theme_score s JOIN theme t ON t.id=s.theme_id WHERE t.code=#{themeCode} AND s.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND s.trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY s.trade_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_score(theme_id, trade_date, model_version, score, rs20, breadth, coverage, evidence_json, day_return, is_synthetic) VALUES(#{themeId}, #{tradeDate}, 'EQUAL_RETURN_V1', #{score}, #{rs20}, #{breadth}, #{coverage}, #{evidenceJson}, #{dayReturn}, #{synthetic}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score= VALUES(score), rs20= VALUES(rs20), breadth= VALUES(breadth), coverage= VALUES(coverage), evidence_json= VALUES(evidence_json), day_return= VALUES(day_return)
